“I’m full and the air conditioning is nice”
Jan 2026 • Couples
That’s what my partner said at the end of our meal and I agreed. I thought it summed up our night perfectly. 
The good - decor is nice, staff were friendly and the AC was good
The not so good - the steaks were of very average quality and for the price you pay (it’s advertised as Australian beef), I’ll eat my steak at home. It was a Monday and they had a 2 for 1 special, still expensive for what we had, average food and poor quality wine. 

Stick with all the beautiful Vietnamese food is my recommendation🤷‍♂️
